target.description: Typed TypeScript function sN alias or path#functionName. Analysis reads source but grants no edit or validation coverage.

assertion.description: Boolean expression over input names and result. Supported pure scalar subset only. A bounded no-counterexample result is not project verification.

kind.description: Waits on a command run_task started; it does not run a new command.

run.description: The rN id returned by run_task.

cursor.description: Output position to read from, as returned by the previous result; without it the latest output is shown.

until.description: exit (default): wait until the run ends, up to 4 minutes. output: return as soon as new output arrives. now: return at once.

args.description: Extra argv for a test task, such as filters or --run. Keep task equal to its catalog ID; arguments are passed literally, without shell expansion.

kind.description: Node package.json dependencies only; use command for other package managers.
